description:
Per-pool supply and borrow rates across DeFi lending protocols such as Aave, Compound and Morpho, largest pool (TVL) first. Pass symbol (the pool asset, e.g. USDC), protocol (e.g. aave-v3), chain and/or min_tvl_usd to narrow it. Results are one page: limit 1-100 (default 25), offset 0-10000; pass next_offset to get the next page. Useful for rate-spread screens and stablecoin yield analysis. Use it when the user asks about lending rates, borrow costs or DeFi yield.

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

chain.description: Chain name or slug, e.g. ethereum or base.

min_tvl_usd.description: Leave out pools with less than this total value locked, in USD.

offset.description: Pagination offset in the result units documented by the tool; zero starts the first page.

protocol.description: Protocol or token name, DefiLlama slug or CoinGecko id, case-insensitive exact match.

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

name: get_lending_rates
